note: Audit 537995-c1/537995-s1: Same article, same medium (double distilled water, no additives), same wavelength (1064 nm, the fundamental wavelength named in the claim's conditions) and the same two fluence values (5.8 and 15.5 J/cm2) that the claim's 'both cases' refers to. The series is the TEM particle-count geometric-diameter mean taken from the size histograms of Fig. 4a/b, i.e. exactly the 'mean particle size' the sentence reports, so the claim's no_effect statement and the series' shape are comparable on the stated terms.; caveats: The claim sentence says 'approximately the same', a no-effect statement with an implicit tolerance, while the shape test uses a fixed 10% or 20% allowance at both points. The two means are based on different particle counts (64 at 5.8 J/cm2, 686 at 15.5 J/cm2) and SDs (14.1 and 10.3 nm), so the allowance should not be read as a sampling standard error. The series means are recomputed from the stored histograms (23.9 and 24.3 nm) and differ slightly from the rounded caption values (24 and 25 nm). The claim's quote is a three-sentence run because the claim sentence alone does not name the laser variable.

Audit 537995-c2/537995-s2: Same article, same medium (double distilled water, no additives), same wavelength (532 nm, the SHG named in the claim's conditions) and the same two fluence values (5.3 and 19.9 J/cm2). The series is the TEM particle-count geometric-diameter mean from the size histograms of Fig. 5a/b, the measurement the claim's 'average particle size' refers to, so the claim's increase and the series' shape are comparable on the stated terms.; caveats: The results-section statement of this dependence describes the micrograph ('larger separated sphericallike shaped particles and much Au material distributed as relatively narrow arrays') and the authors call the comparison with the lower fluence 'very provisional' (p.5), because the higher-fluence sample contains interconnected NPs/arrays that may be counted as particles; the higher-fluence point (N=698) therefore carries an aggregation caveat. The series means are recomputed from the stored histograms (6.7 and 14.1 nm) and differ slightly from the rounded caption values (7 and 14 nm).
